# Calculate Expression

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Calculates an expression

## Syntax

~~~~text
calculate(input: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
calculate(input: "(123.4 * 42^42) * 3")
~~~~
